rationale: Price sits at 5.9% of today's range after a high-volume plunge to 56.04 followed by steadily declining volume and four consecutive small-bodied candles that fail to make new lows. This exhaustion pattern is forming well below VWAP ($57.19) and the 9-EMA ($56.90) on a risk-on tape (SPY +1.89%, VIXY -9.75%), removing immediate follow-through selling pressure that justified the original short. Closing locks in the 0.73% gain before a probable stabilization or bounce develops.
